title: PAT: Accelerating LLM Decoding via Prefix-Aware Attention with Resource Efficient Multi-Tile Kernel
authors: Jinjun Yi; Zhixin Zhao; Yitao Hu; Ke Yan; Weiwei Sun; Hao Wang; Laiping Zhao; Yuhao Zhang; Wenxin Li; Keqiu Li
venue_full: ACM International Conference on Architectural Support for Programming Languages and Operating Systems (ASPLOS 2026)
affiliations: Tianjin University; Stevens Institute of Technology
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Continuous batching, Performance modeling, Hardware co-design

problem_statement.en: Decode attention becomes a dominant memory-bound component as requests reuse large hierarchical prefixes such as system prompts, tools, templates, and RAG context. Query-centric kernels reload shared prefix KV cache repeatedly, while fixed KV-centric tiling wastes on-chip resources when prefix groups and suffix lengths are uneven.
problem_statement.zh: 隨著請求大量重用 system prompts、tools/templates 與 RAG context 等階層式 prefix，decode attention 成為主要 memory-bound 元件。Query-centric kernel 會重複讀取共享 prefix KV cache，而固定 KV-centric tiling 在 prefix group 與 suffix 長度不均時會浪費 on-chip 資源。

key_innovation.en: PAT implements prefix-aware decode attention for vLLM with a pack-forward-merge execution pattern. It packs queries by shared prefix, runs a resource-efficient multi-tile kernel selected for each prefix group, forwards work through multiple CUDA streams and long-KV splitting, then merges partial results with online softmax.
key_innovation.zh: PAT 在 vLLM 中實作 prefix-aware decode attention，採用 pack-forward-merge 執行流程。它依共享 prefix 打包 query，對每個 prefix group 選擇 resource-efficient multi-tile kernel，透過多 CUDA stream 與 long-KV splitting 推進工作，最後用 online softmax 合併部分結果。

baselines_compared: FlashAttention, FlashInfer, FastTree, RelayAttention, RelayAttention++, DeFT, Cascade Inference

key_improvements.en: Reduces attention latency by 53.5% on average and TPOT by 17.0-93.1% under the same configurations against state-of-the-art attention kernels. Kernel-level comparisons report speedups up to 21.5x over FlashAttention and 11.7x over FlashInfer in shared-prefix settings; end-to-end P99 TPOT reductions are reported up to 93.4%.
key_improvements.zh: 在相同設定下，相較 SOTA attention kernels，平均 attention latency 降低 53.5%，TPOT 降低 17.0-93.1%。共享 prefix 設定中，kernel-level 相較 FlashAttention 最高 21.5x、相較 FlashInfer 最高 11.7x；端到端 P99 TPOT 降幅最高 93.4%。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (kernel/system paper; reports attention latency, TPOT, TTFT, and P99 reductions rather than predictor error)
models_validated: Llama-3-8B, Qwen3-8B, Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct, Qwen3-30B-A3B, Gemma-family head configurations
validation_workloads: Toolagent trace, BurstGPT-derived conversation trace, Synthetic shared-prefix workloads

scope_assumptions.en: PAT targets decode attention when substantial shared prefix structure exists. Benefits depend on the prefix cache hit rate, prefix-group packing quality, and kernel integration with the serving runtime; it does not model prefill scheduling, request admission, or multi-node routing.
scope_assumptions.zh: PAT 主要針對具有大量共享 prefix 結構的 decode attention。收益取決於 prefix cache hit rate、prefix group packing 品質、以及 kernel 與 serving runtime 的整合；它不處理 prefill scheduling、request admission 或 multi-node routing。
